Voat is probably dying and it was almost completely avoidable. The admins were basically handed a golden opportunity last June when a bunch of Reddit moved over. What could have been a clear signal to make voat a career was squandered. The site was shut down and no one could log on for days. The result was many people never even got on the site and instead of a community of hundreds of thousands getting online, less than 30 000 users came over to Voat from a community of hundreds of thousands and there are likely very few of those who still regularly participate.

I'm making this post because I'm watching the "days remaining" counter tick down each and I know that if they were honest about the costs involved in running the site ($5,000 hosting and $2,000 Cloudflare) they aren't even coming close to covering the costs of the site through the powers of "The Derminator." In fact selling adspace the way they've chosen to is probably the worst business decision I've ever seen in a long time. According to stats that Atko has posted this site gets 90K unique visitors per day and that traffic is stable (Source). If everyone looked at only 1 page each (and I know you all look at more but we're going on numbers we know) he is selling the ad space for a rate of slightly more than $0.25 per thousand views, way WAY below average. People we calling for ads months ago, but they waited for the last 60 days to roll our some solution that won't even make a dent in their costs.

The Admins on this site (if they ever talk about this site) post vaguely about making a bigger commitment to the site, to adding features (API was announced 2 months ago and nothing has been done), to making this site profitable so that it can exist in the future. A community of a couple hundred thousand cannot support a site that is running a deficit of $7K per month. If they were serious about this site they would have been doing one thing since July of last year, fixing the underlying problems that result in the incredible hosting costs associated with this site. I understand this would mean essentially mean starting from scratch with regard to their infrastructure but they've had a year and it's clear from the information we have been given that the site is not sustainable in its current form and that they've known this since shortly following the fattening.

I don't want it to seem like this I'm ungrateful for the work they've done on the site, I cherish free speech and everything that this site represents. We cannot however continue to ignore the fact that this site is going to die in a matter of months. It's still buggy and running so deep in the red that donating to the site is pretty much the equivalent to throwing your money in a fire. Unless they've secretly been working on a new version of Voat that can support itself or plan to take on outside investors/corporate sponsors then we all know what comes next, a tearful goodbye from the admins, a promise that this is only temporary and voat will return again in a few months time, and a static landing page.

I'm excited to see what happens next, I know this community will persist somewhere else. I just hope that wherever we go, they last a bit longer than a year.
